crude-birth-rate.def: Placeholder: the number of births in a year for every 1,000 people in a population.

crude-death-rate.def: Placeholder: the number of deaths in a year for every 1,000 people in a population.

natural-increase.def: Placeholder: growth from births minus deaths, in percent: (CBR minus CDR) divided by 10.

migration.def: Placeholder: people moving into a country (immigration) or out of it (emigration).

malthus.def: Placeholder: the idea that a population grows faster than its food supply until famine or disease checks it.
